company.title: Company profile
company.description: Information shown on receipts, invoices and reports
company.name: Company name
company.logoSectionDesc: The company logo appears on receipts and templated reports (HTML/PDF only — thermal printer receipts are not supported yet).
company.logoHint: Accepts an external URL (https://...), local path (/path) or an uploaded data:image/... URL. Max 256 KB.
company.logoTooLarge: Logo file is too large. Max 256 KB allowed.
company.errLogoInvalid: Logo URL must start with https://, / or data:image/...

pos.title: POS terminal
pos.modeFuture: Reserved for future use (no effect yet)
pos.autoLogoutHint: Sign the user out automatically after this many minutes of inactivity. 0 = disabled (recommended). Auto-logout is paused while a shift is open.
pos.quickAccessHint: Maximum number of products shown in the POS terminal's quick-access panel.
pos.holdOrderDesc: Allow cashiers to park orders and resume later
pos.mixedPaymentDesc: Allow multiple payment methods on one order
pos.requireCustomerCreditDesc: Credit sales must have a selected customer
pos.requireCustomerAlways: Note: the system always requires a customer for credit sales — this toggle is informational.
pos.lowStockDesc: Show a toast when an added item drops to or below its min-stock threshold (or 10 units)

loyalty.cardDesc: Customers with master pricing earn bonus points per payment. Points use actually paid amounts only (excludes unpaid credit).
loyalty.masterEnableDesc: When enabled, customers with pricing tier master earn points automatically.
loyalty.pointsHint: e.g. 1000 means 1 point per 1000 UZS paid (integer part).
loyalty.generalEnableDesc: Registered non-master customers can also earn per your scope rules.
loyalty.redeemEnableDesc: Apply discount from selected customer balance.
loyalty.advancedDesc: Expiry, tiers, campaigns — loyalty.advanced.* exists in DB; logic comes in a later version.

payment.title: Payment methods
payment.description: Enable methods and customise their display labels
payment.creditHint: Credit sales require a selected customer.
payment.terminalHint: Standalone bank-terminal indicator. The POS UI currently uses the 'Card' button for both.
payment.mixedNote: Split / mixed payment is controlled in POS terminal settings (POS → Enable mixed payment).
payment.errNoMethods: At least one payment method must be enabled.

tax.title: Tax
tax.inclusiveDesc: Tax is included in product prices
tax.perProductDesc: Allow different tax rates per product

receipt.title: Receipt & printing
receipt.middlePh: e.g. bank details, return policy, promo
receipt.middleHint: Printed after the product list and before totals and payments.
receipt.templateNote: Note: if you've built a custom layout in the Receipt Designer (Barcode Center), the toggles below can OFF-override the template, but they cannot force-show an element that the template explicitly hides.
receipt.autoPrintHint: After a sale completes, the receipt prints automatically — no need to click the 'Print' button.
receipt.showLogoHint: The logo from Company profile is shown at the top. HTML / template print only.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.batchDesc: Batch tracking for COGS and reporting. When enabled, sales require batch allocation.
inventory.batchEnableConfirm: Enable batch mode? Mandatory from next day 00:00 after cutover; opening batches will be created for current stock.
inventory.batchDisableConfirm: Disable batch mode? (Data is kept; enforcement only stops.)
inventory.batchResetConfirm: Reset cutover? Unused opening batches will be deleted and a fresh cutover (next day 00:00) will be created. This is not reversible.
inventory.batchAlertText: After cutover, insufficient batch quantity blocks a sale. Fix stock via adjustments only.
inventory.trackingDesc: Toggles inventory sections in the UI. Real per-product tracking is controlled by the 'Track stock' flag on each product.
inventory.minStockHint: New products are created with this minimum stock by default (overridable per product).
inventory.negHintBlock: Cannot sell when stock is zero
inventory.costCalcHint: The system uses a 3-step chain: FIFO batch allocation → latest purchase receipt cost → product purchase price. This setting is ignored when batch mode is enabled.
inventory.batchCostNote: Average cost is not used in batch mode; FIFO applies.
inventory.approvalNotImplemented: Note: this setting is informational only — adjustments are applied immediately.

numbering.title: Numbering & IDs
numbering.description: Prefixes and formats for document numbers
numbering.orphanDesc: The system currently uses built-in defaults: sales ORD-…, return RET-…, purchase PO-YYYY-…, movement MOV-…. Your edits are saved and will take effect once the prefix wiring lands. Format fields are read-only.

security.title: Users & security
security.minPasswordHint: Informational for now. Password policy will be enforced in a future release.
security.sessionTimeoutHint: Note: live cashier auto-logout uses auto_logout_minutes from the POS terminal settings.
security.multiSessionDesc: Users can sign in from multiple devices
security.orphanDesc: Password policy, lockout, session timeout and audit-log toggles are saved but currently use built-in defaults. Real auto-logout and RBAC come from POS settings auto_logout_minutes and role checks.

localization.title: Localization
localization.currencyHint: The system currently hardcodes UZS. This field is reserved for future multi-currency support.
localization.currencyOrphanDesc: Language (default_language) applies immediately. Currency code, symbol, position and separators are saved but UI/calculations are UZS-only. Reserved for future multi-currency support.

offline.title: Local data
offline.description: Main data is stored in SQLite on desktop. Here you can clear browser-layer storage only.
offline.autonomousP1a: POS, products and orders are stored in your
offline.autonomousP2: For multiple tills on one database, use the HOST/CLIENT tab.
offline.clearDesc: Clears localStorage and sessionStorage (e.g. legacy keys). Does not affect SQLite.
offline.noteDesc: For full database reset, open the System Reset tab as admin.
offline.clearConfirm: Browser storage will be cleared. Continue?
offline.toastClearedDesc: Browser storage cleared. Reload if needed.

network.title: Database source
network.description: Use a local SQLite file on this PC or connect to a server over the network. Restart the app after saving.
network.databaseSourceLocalDesc: Opens pos.db on this device. Best for a single till.
network.databaseSourceRemoteDesc: No local DB — all data comes from the remote HOST.
network.localDbPathHint: Used only in local database mode.
network.restartRequired: After changing the mode, fully quit and reopen the app.
network.hostLanDesc: In local mode, other PCs can connect to this machine as CLIENT.
network.configMissingDesc: window.posApi.appConfig not found. Check Electron preload/IPC.
network.modeHint: HOST opens pos.db. CLIENT has no local DB — all queries go to HOST.
network.hostPortHint: Allow this port in the firewall on the HOST machine.
network.hostSecretHint: CLIENTs use this secret to reach HOST (you may change it).
network.clientUrlHint: Used in CLIENT mode. Static HOST IP recommended.
network.downloadDesc: Save a snapshot (.db) of the current database. In HOST mode the local DB is used; in CLIENT mode the server DB is downloaded.
network.downloadToastErrDesc: Could not download the database backup. Please try again.
network.uploadDesc: Replace the live database with a .db file from your PC (VPS in CLIENT mode, local DB in HOST mode). Admin only. Take a backup first.
network.uploadDialogWarning: This replaces all data on the server. Back up before continuing.
network.uploadDialogBackupHint: A pre-replace backup is created automatically, but an extra backup is recommended.
network.uploadToastOkRestartDesc: Database replaced. Restart pos-server and public-api (or the app will relaunch automatically).
network.uploadToastErrDesc: Could not upload the database to the server. Please try again.

reset.cardDesc: Admin only. Actions are irreversible and affect the local SQLite database.
reset.dangerDesc: Data may be permanently deleted. Ensure you have backups.
reset.browserDesc: Clears localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, caches and React Query. Does not clear SQLite. App will reload.
reset.browserConfirm: Clear browser data? The app will reload.
reset.sqliteDesc: Permanently deletes business data from the local SQLite database. Desktop only. Type DELETE to confirm.

dialogs.unsavedDesc: You have unsaved changes in this section. They will be lost if you leave. Discard and go to the selected tab?
dialogs.resetIntro: The following will be permanently deleted:

toast.netSavedDesc: Network settings saved. Restart the app to apply.

errors.dbResetDesktopOnly: Database reset is only available in the desktop app.
